name: Gart Mistrunner
summary: At Camp Narache, Gart Mistrunner teaches new tauren their first rites of nature magic on the Red Cloud Mesa.

sections.title: Mentor of the Red Cloud Mesa
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Gart Mistrunner guides the Shu'halo as they return to their ancient druidic path. New tauren druids come to him when they take their first steps on the Red Cloud Mesa, often carrying a note that commends them to his care. Gart teaches them to commune with the natural world. Through that bond, they draw on nature's healing power and Mu'sha's lunar light to mend allies and strike at threats to the land.

faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner trains druids at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. He teaches novice tauren their first spells and rites.

faq.q: What spells does he teach newly awakened druids?
faq.answer: Gart teaches new druids Healing Touch to heal and Moonfire to strike their foes with nature magic.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Mistrunner clan?
faq.answer: Mistrunner is Gart's family name. No account tells of a Mistrunner tribe or says more about his kin; Gart is known as Camp Narache's druid trainer.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, you learn your first communion with the wilds and the gifts of the Earth Mother from Gart Mistrunner.
As a tauren, you see Gart Mistrunner pass the Shu'halo's ancient druidic traditions to the young of Camp Narache.
